author: dcsscd
quote: Grand Theft Auto 6 isn't a perfect game. The story experiences inevitable ups and downs, some missions remain anchored to Rockstar structures that are starting to show their age, certain sections overdo it with gunplay, the geography of Leonidas suffers from a lack of consistency with less biome variety, a true ownership system is missing, and we would have liked to see the PS5 Pro reach 60 frames per second.
